tagline: Generate reliable test files in your browser
privacy: Runs entirely in your browser. No file data is uploaded.
sizeGuidance: Very large files may generate slowly, use substantial memory, or cause the browser to become unresponsive.
tip.text: Text is generated with valid syntax and an exact byte target.
tip.image: The requested resolution is stored in the image header.
tip.video: A short animated stream is created locally, then padded to size.
tip.audio: PCM audio is synthesized locally with the selected sample rate.
tip.fallback: The selected codec is unavailable in this browser; the downloaded extension matches the compatible format.
largeFileWarning: This file is {size}. Generating files over 1 GiB may require substantial memory and time.
limit: The maximum is {max}. The value was reset to the maximum.
tooSmall: This format has a minimum valid size of {size}; the generated file uses that minimum.
mediaFallback: This browser cannot encode {format}; a compatible fallback was generated.
error: Could not generate the file. Please try a smaller size.
